title: Gait HLASM Interpreter
description: A High Level Assembler interpreter for VS Code. Write, run and debug z/Architecture assembler without a mainframe.

title: MCP Switch
description: Let your VS Code agent turn MCP servers on and off. Exposes start/stop/restart/list as language-model tools that drive VS Code's own MCP lifecycle commands — your mcp.json configuration is read, never moved or rewritten.

title: Image Corner
description: Display images from configurable sources in independent VS Code views.

title: Dog on Compile
description: A dancing chihuahua pops up every time your code compiles successfully.
